detail: SOQL injection via unsanitized searchKey parameter
FLS not enforced on SOQL query - unauthorized field read; FLS not enforced on DML update - unauthorized field modification
Record-level sharing not enforced in without sharing class
Excessive system permissions in Support Agent Tools permission set
Guest user can access all Contact records without sharing enforcement; CRUD and FLS permissions not enforced in query; Guest user profile grants access to Contact search without data restrictions
